exposure: caesarean section in the second stage of labor
cohort: 100 women who underwent caesarean section at full cervical dilation, >37 weeks gestation with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation, out of 2400 caesarean deliveries (1700 emergency and 700 elective).
finding: Women who delivered by cesarean in the second stage of labor have a higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage (12%), operative morbidity including wound infection (8%) and fever (17%),  and neonatal morbidity including NICU admission (6%), nursery admission (12%), jaundice (14%), and death (2 cases), though no maternal deaths or visceral injuries occurred.
